themes.name: Customer support, account access & operational processes
themes.description: Many users describe slow/unhelpful support and account access issues that caused real financial harm. Concrete complaints: "worst customer service. Took more than 2.5 hrs for one response", "I have been locked out... ReKYC ... well over a week, and my account is still completely frozen", "support chat to manually execute the trade ... I was completely ignored", "The escalation team operates in a continuous loop, closing out my tickets with automated, copy-pasted templates". Other operational issues: delayed redemptions, blocked withdrawals, mandate/UPI notification failures.

themes.name: App stability, performance & UI (charts, lag, device support)
themes.description: Frequent reports of app crashes, chart lag, delayed real-time prices, and poor tablet/iPad support. Concrete complaints: "the charts started lagging very badly after update", "bit by bit graphs are not getting updated immediately", "App stopped working with old android OS since october 2026", "I have this on my phone but it would be great guys if you bring iPad specific interface", "When we open the charts the back button on our phone just disappears". Users also dislike frequent/unstable UI changes and reduced chart/indicator functionality after updates.

themes.name: Missing features & product gaps for traders and investors
themes.description: Requests for features and reports of removed/limited functionality: indicators/advanced charting and TradingView integration, scalper mode disappearance, GTT/stop-loss in some order types, home widgets, iPad/tablet layout, more SIP/autopay reliability, additional timeframes/returns in MF dashboard. Concrete complaints: "Please add ... All candle stick patterns, volume, RSI", "Scalper Mode disappered", "key features like stoploss in GTT orders ... are missing", "Please introduce home screen widgets", "When investing in mutual funds ... cart ... no way to access the cart after the fund is added".

themes.name: Pricing, brokerage and unclear/extra charges
themes.description: Widespread complaints about high brokerage, extra/opaque fees and perceived unfair charges. Concrete complaints: "high brokrage", "Groww charges tooo much as brokerage", "Flat 5 rs new Extra Charge for every stock purchase", "Lost almost 5lakh in charges", "Brokerage charges + External charges and Taxes need to be lower". Users compare competitors offering lower/no brokerage and say costs materially reduce retail returns.

themes.name: Order execution reliability & trading correctness
themes.description: Users report orders failing, executing at wrong prices, or executing with delays/slippage during fast markets. Concrete complaints: "I putting target to sell on 95 but it sell on 93", "stop loss doesn’t get placed", "order processing slow hai", "order was clearly in profit, but when I tried to exit, the order failed or did not execute properly multiple times", "stop-loss order got triggered incorrectly at a higher price (₹148.18) when the actual market price was at ₹146.90". Traders also report missing/mismatched fills and lost trades (e.g., F&O/lot disappearance) and square-off timing/charges problems.

weekly_pulse:
# Weekly Product Pulse — Groww — 2026-10-16

## Top themes
Context: 2026-07-25–2026-10-16; data through 2026-10-14. 13,034 reviews; 2,001 substantive.
Customer support, account access & operational processes (550); App stability, performance & UI (charts, lag, device support) (470); Missing features & product gaps for traders and investors (457).
Reviews flag recurring issues: account/support friction, app stability and missing trader features, plus repeated customer reports of unclear brokerage deductions and fee transparency.

## Supporting user quotes

> “"Transaction Successful," the funds were never credited to my bank account.”

> “the app does not properly support landscape mode.”

> “the “Similar Funds in the Same Category” section has been removed.”

## Key observation
Customers repeatedly report unclear/unexpected brokerage deductions and opaque fee breakdowns.

## Product action ideas
1. Publish per-trade fee breakdown and brokerage calculation logic
2. Add in-app transaction/funds reconciliation and real-time status
3. Announce/restore removed fund-comparison features and roadmap
explanation_bullets: For regular equity orders Groww’s published brokerage is the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% of order value per executed order, with a special lower-of minimum rule that applies when computed brokerage is small (the minimum is the lower of ₹5 or 2.5% of the trade value). This applies per executed order and is distinct from other regulatory and exchange charges that together make up total charges.

For F&O orders the published brokerage is a fixed ₹20 per order; NRI-specific rates differ and Groww documents NRI equity brokerage with a higher minimum and a separate F&O per-order amount, so check the NRI line items for applicability to your account.

Brokerage is only one component of your statement’s total charges; regulatory/statutory fees, exchange transaction charges, DP charges, GST and conditional penalties (for example auto square-off or delayed payment charges) are itemised separately and together make the total charge amount shown.

Certain account or funding contexts change brokerage: MTF buy orders and MTF conversions carry 0.1% brokerage by order value plus interest on funded amount; using UPI Mandate balance for equity orders attracts 1% of order value with no cap; these are documented exceptions and apply only in the specified contexts.
